# Rocky Gorge Rugby

> Rocky Gorge Rugby Football Club: Division I and III men's rugby in Central
> Maryland (Columbia, MD). Schedules, results, player histories, and club info.

## Club

- [Home](https://rockygorgerugby.com/): recent results, events, store, calendar
- [Events](https://rockygorgerugby.com/events): fundraisers and club events
- [Gauntlet leaderboard](https://rockygorgerugby.com/gauntlet): season standings
- [Calendar](https://rockygorgerugby.com/calendar): training, matches, events
- [Hall of Fame](https://rockygorgerugby.com/hallOfFame): club history and inductees

## Games and players

- Game pages live at `/game?id=<fixtureId>` with lineups, scores, and match events.
- Player pages live at `/player?id=<playerId>` with games played and scoring history.
- [Player stats index](https://rockygorgerugby.com/stats): per-player aggregates.

## Machine-readable data

- [Recent scores snapshot](https://rockygorgerugby.com/data/scores.json): latest
  scored fixtures (home/away teams, scores, dates, crest URLs). Refreshed each build.
- [Player histories](https://rockygorgerugby.com/data/players.json): per-player
  game logs and scoring events keyed by player id. Refreshed each build.
- Team crests: `/crests/<teamId>.webp` (96px WebP; falls back to the CMS URL).

## Optional

- [Dues and payments](https://rockygorgerugby.com/dues): registration, supporters, sponsorships
